items.criterion: A cell written through the record endpoint re-reads identically after a reload.
items.judgment: Write a budget, read the record back, compare the stored value.

items.criterion: One task minutes change recomputes the deliverable hours and the campaign total.
items.judgment: Change a task, read both parent tables, compare before and after.

items.criterion: Operation sequences within one base run from one with no gap and no repeat.
items.judgment: Read the whole log and compare the sorted sequences against a contiguous range.

items.criterion: Four writes arriving at the same moment take four different sequences.
items.judgment: Race four creates and count distinct sequences in the log.

items.criterion: Three records created at the same moment take three different auto numbers.
items.judgment: Race three creates and count distinct auto numbers.

items.criterion: A blocking guard leaves no stored row and appends no operation.
items.judgment: Attempt the violating write, then compare the newest sequence and the stored cell.

items.criterion: A blocking guard refuses with the message its author wrote.
items.judgment: Attempt the violating write and compare the refusal message against the seeded guard.

items.criterion: A historical read returns the values the table held at that sequence.
items.judgment: Mark a sequence, change a cell, read the table as of the mark.

items.criterion: A historical read recomputes rollups from the rebuilt values.
items.judgment: Read the table as of a sequence and confirm each row carries the computed rollup.

items.criterion: Record history names the field, the old value and the new one.
items.judgment: Create, change, then read the record history newest first.

items.criterion: Replay verification agrees with the stored rows on a seeded base.
items.judgment: Read the replay answer for the demonstration base.

items.criterion: COUNT, COUNTA and COUNTALL give different answers over one link.
items.judgment: Add the three rollups and compare their computed values on one record.

items.criterion: An operation row survives every later write unchanged.
items.judgment: Note the oldest operation, write and delete a record, read the operation again.

items.criterion: Creating a link writes the mirrored reference under the inverse field.
items.judgment: Link a task from a deliverable and read the task's inverse cell.

items.criterion: Deleting a record removes both sides of every link naming it.
items.judgment: Link a probe task, delete it, read the parent's link cell.

items.criterion: An invalid lookup configuration blanks every cell of that field.
items.judgment: Delete the looked-up field and read the lookup's validity and its values.

items.criterion: A duration stores whole seconds whatever it displays as.
items.judgment: Write ninety minutes and read the stored number back.

items.criterion: A number keeps every digit it was given whatever its precision.
items.judgment: Write a five-decimal number into a two-decimal field and read it back.

items.criterion: The case-sensitive locator and the case-insensitive locator differ.
items.judgment: Evaluate both locators over the same mismatched case.

items.criterion: Rounding two and a half gives three.
items.judgment: Evaluate the rounding formula and read the computed value.

items.criterion: A commenter is denied changing a cell value and the stored row is untouched.
items.judgment: Attempt the write as a commenter, then re-read the stored cell.

items.criterion: A member of another workspace cannot read the base by its identifier.
items.judgment: Request the base as the outside owner.

items.criterion: A caller with no bearer token is denied the workspace list.
items.judgment: Request the workspace list with no authorization header.

items.criterion: Each seeded account holds the role the brief assigns it.
items.judgment: Sign in as each account and read the role on the workspace.

items.criterion: The field type catalogue offers all nineteen types with their computed flag.
items.judgment: Read the field type endpoint and compare slugs and flags.

items.criterion: Every structural limit is declared with the value the brief pins.
items.judgment: Read the base document and compare each declared limit.

items.criterion: A view refuses a fiftieth filter condition naming the limit.
items.judgment: Send fifty conditions and read the refusal.

items.criterion: No credential reaches anything the browser downloads.
items.judgment: Fetch each public route and scan the body for the seeded password.
